## The problem

<!--
Describe the problem, not the solution. "I cannot see X when Y" is a problem.
"Add a button that does Z" is a solution, and it hides the actual need.
-->

## Who has this problem

<!--
Who is affected — a coaching client, a coach, an admin — and how often does it
come up? A feature that is real but rare is still worth filing; just say so.
-->

## Possible approaches

<!--
Optional. If you have a shape in mind, describe it. It is fine to have none —
sometimes the problem is the whole contribution.
-->

## Does this need new data?

<!--
If it needs a new table, column, or env var, say so. Anything that writes to the
database needs RLS policies and a migration, which is worth knowing up front.
-->

- [ ] Needs a new database table or column
- [ ] Needs a new environment variable
- [ ] Needs a new external service or dependency
- [ ] Needs a tier gate (subscription-gated)

## Alternatives considered

<!-- What else did you think of, and why is it worse? -->

## Scope check

<!-- Tick honestly. This affects how the request gets scheduled. -->

- [ ] Small — a UI change or a hook
- [ ] Medium — a new component plus an API endpoint
- [ ] Large — a new subsystem (billing, realtime, offline, RAG)
